# Compatibility and Versioning Checklist: ISK-0002 — Public Contracts & Versioning Discipline

**Purpose**: Check that the versioning policy, break catalog, compatibility harness, and its diagnostics are fully and consistently specified
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the versioning policy stated for both the period before ISK-0086 and after it, including what replaces the declaration rule? [Completeness, Spec §FR-030, TR-4]
  - FR-030 and the contract's Versioning policy cover both periods. After ISK-0086 the contract is revised to point to its release rule.
- [x] CHK002 - Does the break catalog list every change kind FR-031 requires, each with a rule ID? [Completeness, Spec §FR-031]
  - S1 to S9, W1 to W6, and G1 to G5 cover every kind FR-031 names, including parser tightening (W4) and ID text form changes (W4).
- [x] CHK003 - Is it specified how a package version changes when its surface changes, and what an unchanged package's version must be? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029, Contract §Versioning policy]
  - Rule V2 and research R4: base plus one when the surface changed, unchanged otherwise, 1 with no base baseline.
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it specified whether changing an error code's client-visible safe message is a compatible change or a break? [Gap, Contract §Break catalog, Tasks T025]
  - **Needs a human decision.** The contract is silent. T025 treats a safe-message change as compatible for the G rules, but the `error-envelope` v1 fixtures pin the message bytes, so editing a message used in a fixture fails W5, and updating the fixture fails W6. The same edit is compatible or a break depending on whether a fixture happens to use the code.
- [x] CHK005 - Are the declaration fields of a break record entry, and who may approve one, fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033, Contract §Declaring a break]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the treatment of deprecation specified, including its required message form and that later removal is a break? [Completeness, Spec §FR-032, Contract rule V4]
- [x] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for removing a public contract package, or for a package losing its public contract role? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Tasks T028]
  - T028 reports S1 for every type in a base baseline whose package is no longer a public contract package, so the removal fails until declared.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 - Is "unsupported breaking change" in the acceptance evidence defined in testable terms? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
  - The Assumptions define it as a break catalog change that the break record does not declare, until ISK-0086.
- [x] CHK009 - Is the comparison point for "a change" (what the harness compares against) unambiguous? [Clarity, Contract §Harness, Research R3]
  - The merge base with `origin/main`, read with `git show`, and overridable with `ISKENDER_COMPAT_BASE`.
- [x] CHK010 - Is "public surface" defined precisely enough to decide whether a protected member of a sealed type is included? [Clarity, Contract §Public .NET surface]
  - Public types, and public or protected members of types visible outside the assembly. A protected member of a sealed type is in the surface by that wording, which is the conservative choice.
- [x] CHK011 - Is the difference between a new break record entry and a historical one defined, so that a declared break passes on its own PR and later? [Clarity, Contract rule H2]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK012 - Is the break catalog in the spec consistent with the catalog in the contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, Contract §Break catalog]
- [x] CHK013 - Are the per-package contract versions consistent between the spec, the plan, the contract, and the tasks? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029, Contract §Versioning policy, Tasks T002]
  - `core-contracts`, `providers-abstractions`, and `policy-sdk`, each at 1, in every artifact.
- [x] CHK014 - Is the version-increment rule (V2) safe when two PRs that change the same package are open at once? [Consistency, Contract rule V2, `docs/18-branch-protection.md` R2]
  - R2 is applied with `strict: true`, so a PR must be up to date with `main` before it merges. The second PR's merge base then includes the first, and V2 requires the next increment.
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the treatment of a safe-message edit consistent between the registry rules (G) and the wire rules (W5, W6)? [Conflict, Tasks T025, Contract §Wire contracts]
  - **Needs a human decision.** Same question as CHK004, seen from the consistency side.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 - Is the named acceptance evidence ("fixtures and compatibility checks fail on unsupported breaking changes") traceable to measurable criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, FR-038, Contract rule H8]
- [x] CHK017 - Can SC-003 ("a reader can identify the contract, item, change kind, and fix") be checked objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, FR-040]
  - FR-040 and the contract's Violation format name every required part of the message, so the check is whether each part is present.
- [x] CHK018 - Are the harness's offline and no-credential requirements measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, FR-039]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 - Does the spec define the harness's behavior when it has nothing to check (no packages, baselines, fixtures, or base)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-037, Contract rule H1]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the case of a baseline edited to hide a break covered? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-036, Research R3]
- [x] CHK021 - Are stale or repeated break record entries covered? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-033]
- [x] CHK022 - Are enum renumbering, nullability changes, and required-parameter changes classified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract S4, S5, S8]
- [x] CHK023 - Is it specified that every failure in a change appears in one run, in a stable order? [Coverage, Spec §FR-041, Contract §Violation format]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 - Is the dependency on `origin/main` being present locally stated, together with what happens when it is missing? [Dependency, Contract §Known limits]
  - Stated as a known limit. CI and the Release workflow both check out with `fetch-depth: 0`, so `origin/main` is present there.
- [x] CHK025 - Is the relationship with ADR-0030's `-alpha` versions, and the absence of a compatibility commitment during alpha, stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Accepted decisions]
- [x] CHK026 - Is AV-4 (offline harness runs) assigned to a validating task? [Assumption, Spec §AV-4, Tasks T037]
